skill.name: explainer-engaging
skill.description: Make a 10–30 second continuous-shot explainer for any product, rendered from code to MP4 with sound. One hero element (a ball, a cursor, a file, a message) travels through the product's workflow laid out as stations on one big canvas; the camera follows it, each station reacts as it passes, then the camera pulls out to reveal the whole journey. Use when someone wants an engaging, story-driven, one-take explainer or a loopable product animation.
skill.summary: Create continuous-shot product explainers with workflow animations, synchronized sound, and MP4 exports.
skill.author: barty-bart

security_audit.summary: All 61 static matches reflect documentation syntax or expected rendering operations rather than the alleged threats. Semantic review found expanded browser file access and potentially destructive temporary-directory cleanup. No evidence found of malicious intent, credential theft, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: The renderer launches Chromium with cross-file access enabled and does not restrict page network requests.
remediation.suggestion: Remove --allow-file-access-from-files and serve approved assets from an isolated local server. Block unrelated requests and render only trusted HTML.

remediation.issue: Stills rendering reuses an existing output-derived directory and then deletes it recursively.
remediation.suggestion: Create a unique temporary directory with mkdtemp. Delete only that directory, and reject output collisions unless the user explicitly approves replacement.

semantic_findings.title: Renderer Broadens Local File Access
semantic_findings.description: Chromium launches with --allow-file-access-from-files and loads the supplied HTML without request restrictions. Untrusted page scripts could read other accessible local files and send their contents through network requests.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The launch flag explicitly broadens file-origin access, and page loading has no request allowlist. Exploitation requires malicious or compromised HTML; no exfiltration payload appears.

semantic_findings.title: Cleanup Can Delete a Pre-existing Directory
semantic_findings.description: Stills mode reuses out + '.frames' with recursive mkdir, then recursively removes that directory. Existing unrelated files inside a colliding directory would also be deleted.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Recursive mkdir accepts existing directories, and recursive removal has no ownership check. The deletion is explicit and needs only an existing output-directory collision.

content.value_statement: Product workflows can be difficult to explain in a short video. This skill guides an AI assistant through building continuous-shot animations with synchronized sound and MP4 exports.
actual_capabilities: Map a product workflow into three to six interactive stations connected by one moving visual object.
Guide deterministic HTML animation with camera tracking, zooms, physical contacts, and a final overview.
Plan synchronized Web Audio music and effects, or incorporate a user-provided music file.
Provide a Playwright and FFmpeg renderer for contact sheets, draft videos, and final MP4 exports.
Support motion-blur sampling, parallel rendering, audio normalization, and silent video output.
Specify landscape or portrait layouts and seamless loops, with a default duration of 12 seconds.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or later, FFmpeg, Playwright, and Chromium; these dependencies are not included.
Provides instructions and embedded renderer code, not a finished product animation or standalone application.
High frame rates, motion blur, and parallel workers can require substantial processing time and memory.
The renderer needs trusted HTML and isolated output folders because browser file access and recursive cleanup carry risks.

use_cases.title: Explain a Product Workflow
use_cases.description: Turn a verified product brief into a short loop showing inputs, processing steps, and the final result.

use_cases.title: Prototype an Animated Interface Story
use_cases.description: Explore reactive controls, camera movement, and synchronized feedback before committing to a polished motion design.

use_cases.title: Build a Repeatable Video Export
use_cases.description: Create a deterministic HTML animation and review stills before producing draft and final MP4 files with the supplied renderer.

prompt_templates.title: Start With a Product Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 12-second looping explainer for [product]. It helps [audience] complete [workflow]. Use three stations, a landscape layout, and synthesized sound.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: define the product and let the assistant choose the visual details.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand and Workflow Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [product URL] and these brand assets: [files]. Animate [workflow steps] in a portrait loop. Use only verified claims and supplied logos.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: supply a factual source, brand materials, and a specific format.

prompt_templates.title: Review Timing and Camera Movement
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 20-second explainer for [product] using [steps]. Include a beat sheet, synchronized effects, contact-sheet review, and a draft before final rendering.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: direct the review process and control visual pacing.

prompt_templates.title: Specify a Deterministic Render Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [product] as a deterministic 1920 by 1080 HTML loop. Use seeded effects, embedded fonts, and [music file]. Review before 60-fps motion-blurred export.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: control reproducibility, assets, and final export quality.

output_examples.input: Explain a document organizer: upload a file, assign a category, and find it later. Use a 12-second landscape loop.
output: A document tile moves from an upload control to a category selector and then into a search result.
Each station responds on contact, with short clicks and notification sounds.
The camera reveals the full workflow before returning to the upload control.
Planned deliverables include an interactive HTML preview, a review draft, and final MP4 files.

output_examples.input: Create a portrait explainer for a task planner using our supplied logo and colors. Show creating, scheduling, and completing a task.
output: A cursor types a task, moves through a calendar control, and activates a completion checkbox.
The supplied logo and verified interface labels establish the product identity.
A beat sheet aligns key presses, scheduling feedback, and the completion sound.
Contact-sheet review checks framing and readability before the draft video is approved.

best_practices: Provide verified product wording, three to six workflow steps, brand assets, and a clear audience.
Review contact sheets and a low-cost draft before approving motion-blurred final rendering.
Use trusted HTML and unique output folders; restrict browser file access and replace recursive cleanup with ownership-checked temporary directories.
anti_patterns: Do not invent customer counts, product claims, testimonials, or promotional offers.
Do not replace the continuous workflow with unrelated scenes, multiple moving protagonists, or explanatory text overlays.
Do not render untrusted HTML or reuse output folders containing unrelated files.

faq.question: What information is required to start?
faq.answer: Only the product is required. A website, workflow steps, brand assets, aspect ratio, and music preferences help define the result.

faq.question: Which tools does the workflow require?
faq.answer: Use a supported AI assistant with Node.js 18 or later, FFmpeg, Playwright, and Chromium. The skill includes renderer code, not these dependencies.

faq.question: What files does the workflow produce?
faq.answer: It specifies an interactive HTML preview, review stills, a draft MP4, and a silent final MP4. An audio-enabled page also produces a soundtrack version.

faq.question: Can I use my own branding and music?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply colors, fonts, an authorized logo, and an optional music file. Otherwise, the skill directs the assistant to synthesize music.

faq.question: How long are the animations and renders?
faq.answer: The default animation is a 12-second loop, within a 10-to-30-second range. Rendering time depends on resolution, frame rate, motion blur, and hardware.

faq.question: What precautions should I take before rendering?
faq.answer: Use trusted HTML and an isolated working folder. The supplied renderer broadens local-file access and can recursively delete an existing stills output directory.
